targets.title: Domains or URLs
targets.description: One per line, e.g. shopify.com or https://store.example.com/. Duplicates are removed.

checkDns.title: Check DNS records
checkDns.description: Detect email providers, DNS hosts and SaaS verification records (MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CNAME) via DNS-over-HTTPS.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence (0-100)
minConfidence.description: Hide weak, single-signal guesses below this confidence.

flattenOutput.title: Add a flat 'technologyNames' column
flattenOutput.description: Comma-separated list (with versions), handy for CSV/Excel.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of websites analyzed in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per site (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to fetch and analyze each website.
